Dialog rules (EXP-103-R3, EXP-105, EXP-109): select FlexLayoutButtons by its Components row, then open its Edit FlexLayout Attributes through its canvas adorner (identify the control by the tooltip 'Edit FlexLayout Attributes' or its flexlayouteditadorner DOM id, not by position; a coordinate click is allowed only when no reference exists). The dialog must show Type, Auto Size and a Regions grid; if it shows only Region Index and Margin, it is a component's dialog: Cancel and stop blocked. Select a region row before editing it. ID, Length, Minimum/Maximum Length and Default Margin are text editors (plain fill, Tab); Unit, Orientation, Alignment and Pack are lists (open the list, click the option; record the value). Set Unit and Orientation before Alignment and Pack, because rows appear and disappear with them (Fill hides Alignment and Pack; FormUnit hides Minimum and Maximum Length; for Horizontal, Alignment offers Top, Middle, Stretch and Pack offers Start, Center, End). New regions from the Regions add (+) button get defaults (UNKNOWN<n>_USER, 1 Flex, Horizontal, Top, Start). Click the add button once at a time and check the grid after each click; a click that adds no row or more than one ends the task: Cancel and stop blocked. If a planned option does not exist, record the available options, Cancel once (discarding the dialog's changes) and stop blocked; never pick a substitute. At most one correction per field. Keep every existing region in place (no region deletions, no reordering) and never change Type, Auto Size, Region Index or the dialog's own Margin. Record every edited region's values as displayed and the Regions grid before OK; OK once (record any message), then exactly one Designer Save with its response and the Save state. A blocker inside the open dialog ends with Cancel, never with an open dialog across tasks.

Regions (T3): open the dialog once and record its starting state (expected Type HorizontalBox, Auto Size False, Region Index 4, one region index 0 UNKNOWN0, 1 Flex, Horizontal, Top, Start; if it differs, record it, Cancel and stop blocked). Leave Type unchanged (the tutorial narrates no Type change). Index 0: ID count; Length 1, Unit Flex, Orientation Horizontal and Alignment Top are the defaults (verify, do not re-enter); Pack End. Click the add button once (two rows); index 1: ID spacer, Length 1, Unit FormUnit, other values left at their defaults. Click the add button once more (three rows); index 2: ID cart; Length 1, Unit Flex, Orientation Horizontal, Alignment Top and Pack Start are the defaults (verify, do not re-enter). OK, one Designer Save. Screenshots: the dialog at open; the Regions grid with three rows and the count region before OK; the Save response.
